Pass: no crash, script errors 0, OK line YRows=1 read back, the method compiled, a jitcount yrow line with entries > 0, jitMismatch 0, jitFaults 0. Household: the compiled body is exact for every Sim (host corpus case 251 + the yield task, docs/537 §31), so household untouched = jitMismatch 0 + jitFaults 0 + script errors 0, as for every JIT queue. Read: the jitcount yrow line, and node tools/jit-hot.ts --game-count <job>/ts3native.log --method Motive.UpdateMotiveWithDecay (exits by opcode; jitexit rows can be cut by the 4000-line cap, the yrow line is not). Stop rule input: other exits per entry; the host count is ~19 (callvirt 11, call 4.6), far above jit-hot's 0.1 veto, so a game number near that means the timing queue is skipped and M2 parks. Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/m2-motive-correct-1116.json --no-smoke (~2 x 15 min). Game: Apex + bridge (Bin state apex).
